name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Paint poster focus above image layers with a dark contrast edge. Use transform-only TV preview zoom, three summary lines and lower actions. Add decorative Jellyfin branding and a separate Home button. TV fallback height is 50vh; Media Bar 3.0.0.4 defaults to 50 percent.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
